description: N16, the judge not the share: the real run on seeds 4101-4105. Trains rw-oracle and sub20-oracle (head A judges the discount) at full length; the exploratory warm-up arms rw-b2w and rw-b4w are dropped by the calibration's rule (--drop). Re-measures N13's n80-rw, N12's sub20 and clean, and N14's sub20-rw, sub10, sub05, sub025 and sub0125 of each seed (read from the n13_signal, n12_bottleneck and n14_dose Drive folders) on the held-out tail's windows 1-512, and measures neglect for every model. NEEDS AN A100: before Run all, choose Runtime > Change runtime type > A100 GPU. On any other GPU it stops before training. About 30 minutes. Resumable: if a session ends, choose Run all again and finished work is skipped.
